testimonials.quote: “My eldest child was tongue tied and my feeding journey got off to a tricky start. Whitney’s support was invaluable. She was so supportive, kind, knowledgeable and non judgemental. She was also there for me with my second, and helped us breastfeed moments after birth (and for the following 15 months). I’m expecting my third and will certainly be calling on Whitney again”
testimonials.name: Laura and Pearl

testimonials.quote: “No words can express how valuable Whitney’s advice was to us when most needed! Her unrushed, gentle and partner inclusive approach made me feel calm and empowered. Thank you Whitney for supporting me to have an amazing (still on going) breastfeeding experience! You are gold!!”
testimonials.name: Petra and Athena

testimonials.quote: “Where do I begin…Whitney is a wonder! Her support throughout my pregnancy with antenatal expression and after our daughter was born with pumping and breastfeeding saw our premature baby exclusively breastfed. Her dedication to research and support for our unique journey was completely invaluable”
testimonials.name: Izzy and Margot

testimonials.quote: “Whitney, we can't thank you enough for all of your support and saving our feeding journey. When I contacted you about my 9 week old baby son, I was at my wit's end. I thought we were dealing with a bottle aversion as he wouldn't take a bottle, I couldn't breastfeed and I had already tried lots of different feeding positions, 4 different bottles, a GP who said it was just silent reflux and a handful of different healthcare professionals who told me he didn't have a tongue tie. I'm so glad I found you, as soon as I spoke to you on the phone, you instantly made me feel at ease. Your professionalism, support and guidance to establish a CMPA (cow's milk protein allergy) and a posterior tongue tie was exactly what we needed when I felt like no one was listening. I would fully recommend anyone to approach you to investigate their precious baby's feeding issues, as honestly you've changed Phoenix's quality of life, and helped him enjoy his favorite thing to do, feed! And helped a very tired, frustrated and upset Mumma who just wanted to be able to feed her baby! Also your fast turnaround just made me feel like someone else was as worried as I was. My midwife in my pocket, thank you!
testimonials.name: Holly and Phoenix

testimonials.quote: “Whitney is an absolute star. My baby Edwin and I got off to a tricky start with breastfeeding as he was tongue tied and had a very shallow latch. This made my breasts engorged, feeding more difficult for Edwin and painful for me, during which he struggled to regain his birth weight. Whitney was wonderful during the snip procedure and for many days after, providing support once I was home from hospital with his latch and feeding plan. She always explained things so well and was so kind and patient with my many many questions. She provided support during a difficult time which I will not forget and is truly impressive and passionate with the work that she does. I could not recommend her enough.
testimonials.name: Rowena and Edwin

googleReviews.name: Erif
googleReviews.text: We first met Whitney when our baby was only a few days old and breastfeeding was a real struggle. I was in a lot of pain but we had been told there was no concern of a tongue tie. Whitney immediately made us feel at ease, listened to and supported. After a thorough tongue tie assessment and diagnosis we were given the time, information and support to make a decision we felt confident and happy with. We continued to see Whitney for follow up feeding support and our baby is now 9 months old and, though it hasn't always been easy, we have been able to continue our breastfeeding journey. Whitney has been a continued source of encouragement, information and guidance throughout and I really can't recommend her services enough.

googleReviews.name: Megan
googleReviews.text:
I’d thoroughly recommend Whitney for any issues related to tongue tie or breastfeeding more generally. She is the perfect balance of professional, experienced, responsive, friendly and reassuring.

We asked Whitney to help us with our daughter’s suspected tongue tie, after multiple health visitors told us there was no issue. Whitney was incredibly knowledgeable, carried out a thorough assessment, and really assisted us with making an informed decision about suitable treatment which was specific to our needs. I knew my daughter was in excellent hands throughout, and Whitney took the time to talk through all our concerns and questions. Whitney was also able to squeeze us into her busy schedule at short notice and arrange a home visit. Our little one’s reflux and gas issues have significantly improved since the procedure and she continues to improve with her feeding. My only regret is not calling her sooner. Thank you so much Whitney!

googleReviews.name: Nick
googleReviews.text:
My wife and I noticed our son was having difficulty when weaning and suspected an undiagnosed tongue tie at 6 months old.

My wife contacted Whitney after she was highly recommended by a friend and she has the following to say….

‘Whitney arrived at our home promptly and I felt instantly at ease. She took her time to fully assess my son and explained all of our options. I felt confident in her advice and proceeded with the treatment. She remained with us for some time afterwards and ensured we felt comfortable with the next steps.

We received follow up contact but, I knew I could contact Whitney at any time if I had any questions’

Thank you - he is like a different baby.

I would highly recommend Whitney and anyone thinking about getting assessed or just needing some advice should contact her without hesitation.

googleReviews.name: Josephine
googleReviews.text: Whitney has been an invaluable support at a stressful time in my breastfeeding journey. She's got a really warm and friendly manner which puts you immediately at ease. She listens and offers support and practical help. She's also very knowledge and will patiently answer lots of questions!

googleReviews.name: Natasha
googleReviews.text: Whitney was professional, kind, and thorough, she talks through everything with you and makes sure you have all the options. Great after care too. Would recommend to anyone.

googleReviews.name: Sarah
googleReviews.text: I cannot recommend Whitney enough. I suspected my 11 week old daughter had a tongue tie due to feeding issues and was recommended Whitney. She was extremely knowledgeable, thorough in her assessment and so friendly :) As my daughter did have a tongue tie we decided to go ahead with the procedure and Whitney put us completely at ease before and after. Her aftercare advice was great and was always at the end of the phone/text for questions.

googleReviews.name: Sam
googleReviews.text: We were in desperate Need of help for our little ones feeding problems. Another tongue tie specialist out of our area recommended Whitney to us and It was a great recommendation. Whitney was able to come to us the next day and instantly know what was causing our little ones issues. She was able to release his tongue tie the same day!! She also covers all aspects of feeding and has so much knowledge . After having these problems since birth we only wish we found her earlier. I would definitely recommended Whitney to any parent who is concerned about there little ones feeding. She’s is also a very lovely person :)

googleReviews.name: Victoria
googleReviews.text: Extremely kind and friendly. Made us feel comfortable and fully informed with our decisions and gave us all the information beforehand. The procedure was also seamless. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend. Already seeing some improvements and appreciated the follow up after a week. Thank you!

googleReviews.name: Gini
googleReviews.text: Whitney corrected my sons tongue tie at 6months and was so kind and compassionate from start to finish. She did a thorough assessment and explained her findings and discussed how this impacted things I didn’t even realize were connected. It meant I could make an informed decision about his procedure and have confidence that it was the right thing to do. The procedure was straightforward and the aftercare follow up brilliant. I trusted that I could speak to her with any concerns that I had which helped put my mum guilt at ease. Thank you Whitney! X

googleReviews.name: Sirous
googleReviews.text: Very friendly midwife the baby is much more better now

googleReviews.name: Niamh
googleReviews.text: Whitney gave us great support around my baby's tongue tie and feeding issues - from the procedure at our house to really thorough and supportive follow up. I just wish I'd found Whitney at the start of our challenges instead of 9 weeks in!

googleReviews.name: Jess
googleReviews.text: My 9 week old daughter had bad reflux and was sick a lot after each feed, after being told by numerous doctors & health visitors on the nhs that my daughter didn’t have tongue tie I knew she had the symptoms so took matters into my own hands and found Whitney. Whitney has so much knowledge and has helped us to find out what was causing our little ones problems. It turned out our baby had a posterior tongue tie and Whitney cut her tongue tie for us there and then! She is so lovely & put us and our baby at ease, explaining everything to us and answering any questions we had. Since seeing Whitney my baby is now being less sick and is never sick when burping (always used to with every feed) and it’s been under 2 weeks! She is also much happier in herself! Would definitely recommend!

googleReviews.name: Sue
googleReviews.text: We had a fantastic experience with Whitney, both with the tongue tie procedure and follow up lactation consultancy. She’s like your own personal breastfeeding cheerleader and I always came away from speaking to her feeding inspired about what I could achieve. She’s obviously passionate about feeding but doesn’t pressurise you towards a particular goal. Ultimately, she worked with us to find a way I could feed my newborn in a way that works for my family x

googleReviews.name: Evangelia
googleReviews.text: I can’t recommend Whitney enough! She has helped us a lot with our little one with the tongue tie and also with related issues. She has provided a lot of support. Whitney is very experienced and knowledgeable but above all she is very warm and empathic and always available to listen and to help.

googleReviews.name: Sarah
googleReviews.text: Whitney is knowledgeable, supportive, and incredibly helpful. My baby is much more settled, sleeping better, and we’ve been able to continue breastfeeding which was our goal. Highly recommend!

googleReviews.name: Rebecca
googleReviews.text: Whitney came out of hours on a Sunday to find a mum ready to quit breast feeding due to reattached tongue tie and painful breast abscess. Whitney performed a frenulotomy so we didn't have to wait for NHS appointment and gave sound, non judgmental advice on different feeding positions and a robust plan to help reestablish milk supply. Whitney is a professional but still feels like a friend, and thats what we both needed that night. The follow up care is also very appreciated. If you are struggling with any aspect of breast feeding, calling upon Whitney is the best investment you could make.

googleReviews.name: Mary
googleReviews.text:
Thank you for coming into our life at the right time to help us with our baby who had spent her first 7 weeks struggling to feed.

Whitney answered all questions, she found our baby had a tongue tie after we had been told by others and health care professionals that there was “nothing wrong with her feeding” but being an experienced breast feeding mum of 5 children I knew otherwise so I am glad to have found Whitney who listened and found the issues.

A very professional, compassionate, friendly , lovely, kind, caring, amazing woman who listened, and just “got “ what I was saying. I felt at ease and comfortable with Whitney!

Perfect and so greatful.

Our issues have been sorted and we are so grateful to continue our feeding journey, and will deffo have another appt just because it’s nice to speak to someone who knows and understands. see you again within our feeding journey! Xxxx

googleReviews.name: Maggie
googleReviews.text: It was a very nice experience, highly recommend.
